Readings for the cut (skills seat, session `session_01Bz6hxDBqK62NP2W1LATvnt`, 2026-09-16T08:42Z; asked by the maintainer: 「切几个合理,经常改的是哪些」).

**Commits per `packages/spec/src/` directory on `origin/main`, first-parent, 30 days (14 days in brackets), via `git-history.mjs count` after `ensure --days=30`** (window covered, floor 2026-08-10): data 134 (61) · ui 123 (54) · migrations 117 (63) · api 106 (48) · kernel 67 (36) · contracts 66 (33) · system 65 (39) · automation 41 (27) · shared 38 (16) · conversions 31 (15) · ai 23 (12) · security 17 (9) · integration 7 · identity 4 · studio 2 · marketplace 1 · qa 0; root files `stack.zod.ts` 27, `type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts` 34, `index.ts` 10; outside `src/`: `packages/spec/scripts` 122, `packages/spec/liveness` 75; the whole package 708.

**Queue cards by the primary `packages/spec/src/DIR` their text names** (95 `pm:queue` cards read at 2026-09-16T08:41Z; 14 name no path and 17 are tooling by keyword; 21 name more than one directory): ui 14 · api 13 · system 7 · kernel 7 · root `stack.zod.ts` 5 · contracts 4 · data 3 · migrations 3 · conversions 2 · automation 2 · shared 2 · ai 1.

**Two consequences.** (1) Commit heat and queue load differ: `data` is the hottest directory by commits and holds 3 queue cards — other lanes' landings touch it; the queue sits on `ui` and `api`. (2) Some files are touched from every partition — `migrations/` (the ADR-0087 registry every retirement writes), the `liveness/` ledger, root `stack.zod.ts` / `index.ts` / the root pin tests — a partition cannot remove them; sharding, os-regen and the merge queue arbitrate them today, and #8360 (the registry still text-merges) gains value under parallel seats.

**Recommended cut — two partitions now, a third pre-registered:**

| partition | directories | queue today (approx.) |
|---|---|---|
| `spec:core` | data · shared · conversions · migrations · kernel · contracts · system · identity · security · the root files; plus the spec tooling (`packages/spec/scripts/**`, the spec gates, generators, lint rules, the liveness ledger) until the third seat exists | 33 + 17 |
| `spec:surface` | ui · api · automation · ai · marketplace · studio · qa · integration | 30 |
| (pre-registered) `spec:tooling` | the tooling half above, split off when `spec:core` reads above 45 queue cards for a week | 17 |

Cross-partition cards (21 of 95) go to the seat of their primary landing directory; the other seat reads only. More than three partitions would need sub-directory cuts with too little load per seat under today's numbers.

The recommendation in force on this card is option **A** as refined by the readings comment: two seats on `domain:spec` partitioned by directory family — `spec:core` (data · shared · conversions · migrations · kernel · contracts · system · identity · security · the root files, plus the spec tooling until a third seat exists) and `spec:surface` (ui · api · automation · ai · marketplace · studio · qa · integration); cross-partition cards to the seat of their primary landing directory; a third cut `spec:tooling` pre-registered, split off when `spec:core` reads above 45 queue cards for a week. Governing text unchanged from the card body. Freshness gate: the newest comment on this card at recording time is 5694631271 (this seat's readings); no later comment. Same stroke: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` (this card is the implementation card for the charter PR: `lanes/spec.md` partition section, SKILL.md entry parameter `part:` + partition-scoped candidate query and mutex readings + the 分席 clause, core-rules.md's 「每域恰一 PM」 re-keyed per partition, `ensure-pm-labels.sh` label rows); after it lands: the triage seat labels the existing queue by landing directory, a second seat post `[PM seat] domain:spec @ surface` is registered, and the maintainer starts the second session. Dispatch follows the claim protocol at the next free `batch` slot; the PR builds at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (SKILL.md is a mandatory-tier path) and is rules layer ⇒ four-piece + an authorized APPROVED.

**Correction — the decision is NOT made; back to the decision box** — skills seat, session `session_01Bz6hxDBqK62NP2W1LATvnt`, 2026-09-16T08:54Z. The maintainer, on the direct channel, verbatim and untranslated: 「spec分拆没有让你开发,还是要讨论」. The ruling record 5694758281 above therefore stands withdrawn: 「spec 同意你的建议」 was not an authorization to implement, and no dev was claimed or dispatched on this card. Same stroke: `pm:queue` → `needs-user-decision`. Discussion continues on the direct channel; the card's options gain a fourth, put by the maintainer: **D. free-claim multi-seat** — several PM accounts on one `domain:spec` lane with no partition key, each claiming by the existing card-level protocol (assignee set atomically, `Claim:` comment, thread re-read, earlier claim wins, loser yields); the protocol text relaxes only the lane-level mutex (seat readings three / four scoped to the seat post, not the lane) and the 「一座位一车道双射」 clause (one seat per post, N posts per lane); no labels, no relabelling of the existing queue, no `part:` parameter; the same-file serial rule already reads every in-flight claim on the lane, so it holds across seats unchanged. Costs: occasional claim races on the top card of the total order (cheap — the atomic pair and the timestamp arbitration already handle them) and every seat reading the whole lane. The seat's view: D is the smaller text change and needs no relabel; A gives collision-free ownership and per-seat queues. Either is a governed-text change and waits for the maintainer's word.

2. 「你说的是这个吗D. free-claim multi-seat」 — the seat answered yes.
3. 「我已经同意了。」

Read as the decision on this card: **D**. Earlier on the same thread the maintainer's 「spec 同意你的建议」 was recorded (5694758281) and withdrawn on 「spec分拆没有让你开发,还是要讨论」 (5694774788) because the card then carried the partition proposal; the agreement now names the rewritten card, so the withdrawal does not apply to it.

What the ruling authorises, no wider: one skills-lane card — this one — dispatched for the protocol text of option D as written in this body (the `Seat:` claim line; mutex readings 3 / 4 scoped to the seat; the same-domain in-flight check reading other seats' claim file faces; the bijection clauses rewritten to one PM ⇒ one lane, one lane ⇒ a set of seats, one post per seat; `check-half-states.mjs` H38 filtered by seat number with self-test cases). Rules layer (`SKILL.md`, `references/core-rules.md`, `references/seat-post-protocol.md`) ⇒ the PR hangs as a four-piece for an authorized APPROVED, then lands by ruling C; `SKILL.md` mandates the contract-review tier for the build. ⛔ Not authorised by this ruling: any `domain:*` split, new labels, a change to `batch`, or the objectui mirror of H38 (that is #18290's own question).

Same-act label write: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` (one replace). Dispatch follows the lane's batch ceiling (3 / 3 in flight at this record; this card is next in the total order as p2 with a maintainer ruling).
